We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join the Advanced Technology team. We are looking for a Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Navigation intern to join our Advanced Technology team and contribute to advancing ANYmal's mobility capabilities. Utilizing the latest reinforcement learning techniques and simulation tools, we define, train, and integrate ML models into ANYmal to safely and robustly navigate challenging industrial environments. 
Your role includes evaluating and fine tuning state of the art RL-based navigation & locomotion policies  in simulation and on real quadruped robots. This internship provides a profound and impactful opportunity to work at the forefront of machine learning in robotics, playing a significant role in shaping ANYmal's autonomous capabilities and contributing to real-world applications. 
You will work closely with Robotics experts and research partners who will provide you with guidance and mentorship. The preferred starting date is September 2026, and the full-time paid internship lasts six months.

lists.content:
• Project Support: Work closely with our engineers and researchers on active projects across the entire software stack, from application software to autonomy stack and low-level software.
  • Algorithm Implementation: Design, implement, test, and validate new algorithms and features in core software areas.

  • Attitude: A hands-on, proactive, and analytical attitude towards complex problem-solving and eagerness to learn rapidly.

lists.text: Bonus points, a few extra things that would make us especially excited about your application

Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people in Zurich and work on cutting-edge robot technology that is transforming industrial operations globally.

lists.content:
• Develop, test, and help deploy Python-based automated test procedures for ANYmal hardware subsystems
  • Instrument and control hardware devices, sensors, and cameras directly through software interfaces
  • Collaborate with test technicians and manufacturing engineers to refine shopfloor testing workflows
  • Learn to write clean, resilient, and reproducible code using established software engineering best practices
  • Contribute directly to test documentation and technician procedures to ensure seamless shopfloor execution

• Ongoing or recently completed degree (MSc) in Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering
  • Solid Python programming foundation with experience building projects that interact with hardware, sensors, or external APIs
  • Practical hands-on experience with hardware interfaces through university labs, student projects, or personal builds
  • Structured approach to problem-solving and a keen interest in measurement fundamentals like tolerances and repeatability
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfortable explaining technical concepts and drafting structured procedures
  • Proactive mindset with a desire to learn quickly, ask questions early, and work in a hands-on production environment
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Zurich, with a commitment to regular on-site presence near the hardware and shopfloor

• Experience with ROS or ROS2
  • Basic understanding of image processing or computer vision pipelines (OpenCV)
  • Exposure to sensor calibration techniques (IMU, camera intrinsics/extrinsics, depth, or thermal)
  • Familiarity with Docker or devcontainer environments
  • Background in student engineering teams such as Formula Student, Swissloop, or ARIS Rocketry, especially on testing or integration

As our Deal Desk / Commercial Sales Support professional, you will help build the commercial infrastructure that enables our global Sales organisation to operate efficiently as ANYbotics scales.

You will take ownership of the operational flow around our deals, from pricing and quoting through contracting, approvals, purchase orders, order entry, invoicing and renewals. Working across Sales, Legal, Finance and Operations, you will become the central coordination point that keeps commercial activity moving accurately and efficiently.

This is both an execution and process-improvement role. Today, parts of the commercial process span HubSpot, SAP and manual workflows, creating unnecessary administration for Sales and inconsistent handoffs between teams. You will help simplify and standardise these processes, remove bottlenecks and build more scalable ways of working.

The impact should be very tangible: fewer delays, cleaner commercial processes and more time for our salespeople to spend with customers.

ANYbotics transforms industrial environments by bringing autonomous robotic inspection to applications where work can be difficult, repetitive or hazardous.

Our ANYmal robots combine advanced mobility, sensing, autonomy and AI to inspect complex industrial facilities. Our customers include large operators across energy, process and other asset-intensive industries.

This creates an interesting commercial environment. Our deals do not stop when a contract is signed. Orders have downstream implications across Finance and Operations and ultimately lead to the delivery and deployment of physical technology at customer sites.

ANYbotics is a leading robotics company developing autonomous mobile robots for industrial inspection.

Headquartered in Zurich and with a growing international presence, our team brings together expertise across robotics, software, hardware, product, operations and commercial functions.

As our customer base and commercial organisation scale, we are investing in the processes and capabilities needed to support that growth.

• Own and coordinate the commercial process across pricing, quoting, contracting, internal approvals, purchase orders, system entry, invoicing and renewals.

  • Act as a central point of coordination between Sales, Legal, Finance and Operations, keeping live deals moving and resolving operational blockers.

  • Reduce the administrative burden on Sales by creating clear ownership, reliable handoffs and repeatable commercial workflows.

  • Improve how commercial information flows between HubSpot, SAP and downstream Finance and Operations processes.

  • Establish consistent pricing, quoting, contracting and approval processes with appropriate controls and clear visibility.

  • Identify bottlenecks and manual workarounds in the current process and implement practical improvements that increase speed, accuracy and scalability.

• Hands-on experience in Deal Desk, Commercial Sales Support, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Order Management or a closely related role.

  • Experience working across multiple stages of the deal-to-cash or quote-to-cash process rather than specialising in only one step.

  • Practical experience with areas such as pricing and quoting, contracts, approval workflows, purchase orders, order entry and invoicing handoffs.

  • Strong CRM capability and confidence working with structured opportunity, customer and commercial data.

  • Highly organised and accurate, with the ability to manage multiple live deals, stakeholders, priorities and deadlines.

  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills and confidence working with Sales, Legal, Finance and Operations.

  • A process-improvement mindset, with examples of simplifying workflows, removing bottlenecks or improving the way commercial teams operate.

  • Comfortable in a highly hands-on role where success comes from making the commercial machinery work better day to day.

• Experience with SAP or another ERP / order-management platform.

  • Experience with HubSpot.

  • Experience with CPQ, pricing governance, approval matrices or commercial policies.

  • Experience owning renewals, order entry, invoicing coordination or other downstream activities after contract signature.

  • Experience in a B2B technology company with an established Deal Desk or structured enterprise sales process.

  • Exposure to hardware + software, industrial technology, robotics or another environment where commercial orders lead to physical delivery or deployment.

As our Solutions Architect, you will act as the senior industry expert bridging the gap between our autonomous robotic technology and the Power & Utilities sector, and more broadly the maintenance, reliability and asset performance communities of asset-intensive industries. This is a highly visible, strategic role designed for a visionary who thrives on customer engagement, executive networking, and shaping product roadmaps – offering the thrill of a sales-focused environment without the pressure of a quota.

You are the counterpart, in the Product Management organization, to our Key Account Managers. While the Account Manager develops and maintains a high-touch relationship with the customer, identifies key decision-makers and devises the account penetration strategy, you deliver the solution required to fulfil the customer engagement: you aggregate and synthesize the current and future ANYbotics product stack (robot platform, operational design domain, inspection payloads, data insights, data lake integration, APM/CMMS systems integration) into cohesive technical solutions, complete with the business models and contractual frameworks tailored to our top-priority accounts. This role is central to our Go-To-Market strategy, centered on project sales and deeper, more focused engagements with key accounts.

You will define high-impact use cases, orchestrate business value engineering, and mentor our internal teams. If you are passionate about driving product vision and enjoy travelling to connect directly with industry leaders, this role offers unparalleled impact.

ANYbotics is a tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics through Embodied AI across multiple industries. Our autonomous quadruped robots, like ANYmal, are redefining safety and productivity in the world’s most demanding environments – from offshore oil rigs to chemical plants, power plants, substations, utilities and other complex industrial sectors. We provide an end-to-end solution that combines cutting-edge autonomy, high-value data analytics and mechanical engineering excellence, enabling the autonomous inspection and monitoring of large-scale facilities, increasing safety while maximizing uptime for the world’s most critical infrastructure.

This creates an interesting commercial environment. Our deals do not stop when a contract is signed: orders have downstream implications across Finance and Operations and ultimately lead to the delivery and deployment of physical technology, integrated with customer systems, at customer sites.

ANYbotics is a leading robotics company developing autonomous mobile robots for industrial inspection. Headquartered in Zurich and with a growing international presence, our team brings together expertise across robotics, software, hardware, product, operations and commercial functions. As our customer base and commercial organization scale, we are investing in the processes and capabilities needed to support that growth – this role is one of them.

• Architect vertical solutions. Design tailored solutions and define compelling use cases for the Power & Utilities industry, synthesising robotics, inspection payloads and data insights into solutions that integrate seamlessly into customer workflows and systems (APM, CMMS/EAM, historians, DCS/SCADA). Build the supporting business models and contractual frameworks needed to deliver turnkey value.
  • Quantify customer outcomes. Lead business value engineering: build robust business cases with quantitative ROI (avoided downtime, exposure hours, inspection cost, integrity risk) and qualitative benefits, and articulate clearly the tangible business benefits of our autonomous inspection solutions.
  • Partner with executives and the Commercial team. Work closely with prospect and customer executives to drive strategic alignment, lead customer discovery and value engineering workshops, and act as the consultative product partner to Key Account Managers on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Enable Go-to-Market excellence. Develop and deliver sales enablement toolkits – vertical positioning, use-case catalogues, competitive intelligence, reference architectures and training – so the Commercial team can articulate our value and win in your vertical.
  • Evangelize our technology. Represent ANYbotics within the partner ecosystem (APM/EAM software vendors, engineering and service partners), lead professional sessions at industry events, and engage with independent analysts (e.g. Gartner).
  • Shape the roadmap. Bring deep industry insights to product marketing and product management; identify emerging value drivers and work directly with Product Managers and R&D to embed your market vision in the technical roadmap.
  • Mentor. Share critical industry knowledge with the business value consulting team and coach younger engineers and account teams.

• Experience:  At least 15 years of hands-on industry experience in Maintenance or Reliability Engineering, with a strong Asset Performance Management (APM) background, gained within Power & Utilities and/or other asset-heavy industries (Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Metals, high-volume Manufacturing). You have lived the reality of maintenance strategies, integrity programmes and reliability improvement inside operating plants.
  • Interdisciplinary Background:  A well-balanced background bridging software, APM and maintenance; this is not a pure hardware or automation engineering role. A strong understanding of how automated inspection, control and maintenance systems (mobile robotics, IoT, DCS/SCADA, CMMS, APM) fit into complex industrial workflows.
  • Customer and deal leadership:  Proven ability to lead complex customer discovery, navigate executive-level conversations and contribute heavily to major deals; a sharp observer of customer personas and pain points.
  • Financial and contractual fluency:  Comfortable building business cases, navigating pricing models and handling the business and contractual nuances of technical partnerships and strategic agreements.
  • Executive communication and influence:  Excellent written and oral communication skills; able to translate complex technical concepts into high-value narratives for audiences ranging from R&D engineers to C-suite executives, and to motivate internal stakeholders without formal authority.
  • Cross-functional collaboration:  Strong collaboration skills, particularly in partnering with product managers, product marketing and the Commercial organization.
  • Education:  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or related).
  • Grit and mobility:  A self-starter who thrives in the fast-paced environment of a scaling deep-tech company, with high enthusiasm for significant travel (30–40%+) to engage directly with customers, prospects and industry networks.

• Previous experience as a Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales Engineer, Product Manager, Business Value Consultant or Reliability Engineer.
  • Hands-on experience with leading APM/EAM platforms (e.g. GE Vernova APM, AVEVA, Bentley, IBM Maximo, SAP PM/IAM, Hexagon) and their integration patterns.
  • Certifications such as CMRP, CRE, API 510/570/580, or equivalent reliability and integrity credentials.
  • Experience deploying automated or robotic inspection programmes in industrial environments.

The Opportunity


As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will own supplier quality for a portfolio of critical mechanical, electrical and mechatronic suppliers, from supplier qualification through production and continuous improvement.

The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source.

This is a hands-on role: you will not only define processes and requirements, but also audit suppliers, drive corrective actions and make sure improvements are implemented and sustained.

lists.content:
Your Impact

  • Define supplier qualification criteria and establish robust processes for assessing and approving new suppliers.

  • Prepare and maintain supplier audit and assessment frameworks, including questionnaires and checklists.

  • Conduct on-site assessments of critical suppliers and drive audit findings through to closure.

  • Monitor supplier performance, identify recurring quality issues and initiate improvement or development actions where needed.

  • Identify suppliers, manufacturers and service providers requiring Quality Assurance Agreements (QAAs).

  • Develop and maintain QAA templates aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 requirements.

  • Review and negotiate QAA terms with suppliers, covering responsibilities, control points, traceability, non-conformities and other quality requirements.

  • Coordinate internal Quality, Legal and Purchasing approvals for QAAs and monitor ongoing supplier compliance.

  • Define and maintain the supplier NCR process, from detection and reporting through escalation, follow-up and closure.

  • Establish effective NCR templates and tracking tools, and communicate non-conformities clearly with suppliers.

  • Analyse NCR trends and recurring issues to identify systemic quality problems and drive corrective actions.

  • Initiate supplier development, improvement plans or requalification where supplier performance falls below expectations.

• 5 years  experience in supplier quality management with complex mechatronic product

  • Hands-on experience conducting supplier audits and driving corrective actions through to verified closure.

  • Strong understanding of root-cause analysis, 8D  and structured problem solving.

  • Experience defining and negotiating supplier quality requirements, ideally including Quality Assurance Agreements.

  • Ability to work effectively across Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, while challenging suppliers when quality or delivery requirements are not met.

  • Willingness to travel to suppliers and spend time on-site when required.

• Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 80079-34, particularly in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience building or improving supplier quality processes in a scaling manufacturing organization.
  • Familiarity with statistical quality tools such as SPC, Cpk/Ppk and Pareto analysis.

• The opportunity to own supplier quality for a portfolio of components directly contributing to the production of autonomous mobile robots.

  • Direct collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams in Zurich and with suppliers internationally.

  • The opportunity to build and improve supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales its production and product portfolio.

lists.content:
Reporting directly to our CRO, you will own the North American sales strategy, regional target and sales organisation.

You will lead and grow an initially small team, win new strategic customers and expand successful site-level deployments into multi-site, fleet and enterprise-wide adoption. This is a hands-on leadership role, combining regional ownership with direct involvement in our most important customer relationships, deal strategies and negotiations.

Working closely with Solution Architecture, Business Value Consulting, Customer Success and Product, you will build a repeatable enterprise sales approach across our core industrial markets.

• Own and execute the North American commercial strategy across the US and Canada, translating our global ambitions into clear regional, industry and strategic account priorities.

  • Lead and grow the North American sales organisation, hiring, developing and coaching the team to deliver sustained growth.

  • Own the regional sales target and commercial operating rhythm, driving strong discipline across pipeline development, forecasting, account planning and execution.

  • Accelerate enterprise adoption within strategic accounts, converting successful pilots and site-level deployments into multi-site, fleet and enterprise-wide agreements.

  • Win new strategic customers through direct prospecting, industry relationships, partnerships and disciplined enterprise business development.

  • Stay personally involved in our most important opportunities, leading deal strategy, executive engagement, business-value selling, negotiation and closing.

  • Partner closely across Solution Architecture, Business Value Consulting, Customer Success and Product to deliver strong customer outcomes, support successful deployments and feed market insight back into the business.

• A proven sales leadership track record in industrial technology, with a background in industrial automation, robotics, Industrial IoT, Industrial AI, asset performance management, predictive maintenance or inspection technology.

  • Substantial experience selling to North American customers in at least one of our core markets: Power & Utilities, Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Metals & Minerals, cement or pulp & paper.

  • Demonstrated people leadership and commercial delivery, including hiring, coaching and developing sales teams, owning a regional or business-unit sales target, and delivering growth.

  • A genuinely hands-on leadership style, with continued personal involvement in strategic customers, major opportunities, negotiation and closing.

  • A strong record in complex, long-cycle enterprise sales, building quantified business cases and aligning operational, technical, procurement and executive stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated success expanding initial deployments into multi-site or enterprise relationships, with an understanding of the operational and commercial requirements for scaling adoption.

  • Strong commercial judgement and operating discipline, including sales strategy, pipeline development, forecasting and strategic account planning.

• Experience selling solutions that combine hardware, software, services and operational deployment.

  • An established network of industrial customers and strategic partners in North America.

  • Experience building a sales organisation in a scale-up or emerging industrial technology category.
